method: Seven ABBA blocks per comparison, previous Rust or legacy JS as A and candidate as B. CPU measures process user + system milliseconds for 100 captures; packed Vitest measures wall milliseconds per fresh 28-test process. Coverage and separate packed acceptance exercise all compatibility cases. Final capture CPU and acceptance were rerun after extracting guardScalarState for the complexity gate. Whole-suite timing used the preceding tarball with the same checks inline.
timingExclusion: getByLabelText: wrapping <label> labels only its FIRST control

prototypeMeasurements.description: Earlier prototype using the same guard, before splitting its implementation into two functions.

qualification: An earlier exploratory whole-suite run failed a click assertion. Its timings were discarded. The unfiltered final acceptance run passed that test on N-API and WASM.
